# Neomeditech Biomedical Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

> Neomeditech Biomedical Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a Nepal-based business providing medical equipment and related product information for healthcare facilities and other customers.

## Organization Overview
- **Legal Business Name:** Neomeditech Biomedical Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
- **Brand Names:** Neomeditech, Neomeditech Nepal
- **Address:** Tarakeshwar-6, Kathmandu, Bagmati Province, Nepal
- **Official Website:** [https://neomeditech.com.np](https://neomeditech.com.np)
- **Email:** [contact.neomeditech@gmail.com](mailto:contact.neomeditech@gmail.com)
- **Contact Numbers:** +977 9712011758, +977 9712011757
- **WhatsApp:** +977 9712011758

## Medical Equipment Categories

Neomeditech's website provides information about medical equipment and related accessories, including the following categories. Availability and specifications should be confirmed for individual products.

### Respiratory and Critical Care

- Oxygen concentrators
- BiPAP and CPAP machines and accessories
- Ventilators and respiratory accessories

### Cardiology and Diagnostic Equipment

- Multiparameter patient monitors
- ECG machines and accessories
- Ambulatory blood pressure monitors (ABPM)
- EEG equipment

### Emergency and Life-Support Equipment

- Defibrillators and automated external defibrillators (AEDs)
- Crash carts and emergency trolleys
- Infusion pumps and syringe pumps

### Sterilization and Infection Control

- Vertical, horizontal, and tabletop autoclaves
- Sterilization accessories and replacement parts

### Maternal and Neonatal Care

- Radiant baby warmers
- Phototherapy units
- Cardiotocography (CTG) machines and probes
- Fetal Dopplers

### Surgical and Laboratory Equipment

- Bipolar electrosurgical forceps and cables
- Laboratory centrifuges and colorimeters
- Ultrasound systems, probes, and accessories

## Product Information and Support

For current product availability, technical specifications, pricing, warranty conditions, installation, training, maintenance, or repair enquiries, contact Neomeditech directly. Service availability and warranty coverage may vary by product.
